mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BALANCE ( USER_SEQ, BALANCE, TOTAL_BALANCE, OPERATION, COMMENT, SUBTRACT_UNIT_PRICE, SMS_PRICE, LMS_PRICE, MMS_PRICE, REFUND, REG_DATE, REG_ID ) VALUES ( #{userSeq}, #{balance}, #{totalBalance}, #{operation}, #{comment}, #{subtractUnitPrice}, #{smsPrice}, #{lmsPrice}, #{mmsPrice}, #{refund}, NOW(), #{regId} )
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ AS seq, USER_SEQ AS userSeq, BALANCE AS balance, TOTAL_BALANCE AS totalBalance, OPERATION AS operation, COMMENT AS comment, SUBTRACT_UNIT_PRICE AS subtractUnitPrice, SMS_PRICE AS smsPrice, LMS_PRICE AS lmsPrice, MMS_PRICE AS mmsPrice, REFUND AS refund, REG_DATE AS regDate, REG_ID AS regId FROM BALANCE WHERE USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} ORDER BY SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SEQ AS seq, USER_SEQ AS userSeq, BALANCE AS balance, TOTAL_BALANCE AS totalBalance, OPERATION AS operation, COMMENT AS comment, SUBTRACT_UNIT_PRICE AS subtractUnitPrice, SMS_PRICE AS smsPrice, LMS_PRICE AS lmsPrice, MMS_PRICE AS mmsPrice, REFUND AS refund, REG_DATE AS regDate, REG_ID AS regId FROM BALANCE WHERE USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} ORDER BY SEQ DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT b.USER_SEQ AS userSeq, b.TOTAL_BALANCE AS currentBalance, b.REG_DATE AS lastTransactionDate FROM BALANCE b INNER JOIN ( SELECT USER_SEQ, MAX(SEQ) AS maxSeq FROM BALANCE
WHERE USER_SEQ IN
#{id}
GROUP BY USER_SEQ ) latest ON b.USER_SEQ = latest.USER_SEQ AND b.SEQ = latest.maxSeq ORDER BY b.TOTAL_BALANCE DESC
